mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or 20-day returns are negative in 60%+ of easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and rises in unemployment signal economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns in 60%+ of cases or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: GDPC1 deceleration fails to predict negative returns in 60%+ of late-cycle instances or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market, which typically precedes aggressive Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to tightening expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive returns in 60%+ of cases or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth reflects a healthy labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth fails to predict positive returns in 60%+ of cases or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
